body: As the envelope shuffles closer, a wave of protectiveness engulfs me. My hands tremble slightly as I reach out tentatively to touch its smooth surface. The ink of my handwriting glimmers under the light of the desk lamp. But before I can read the contents or even contemplate opening it, a voice whispers softly from behind me: "Please don't open that." Turning around, I see a familiar face - one that has been lost for far too long. Tears well up in my eyes as I realize he may be about to leave again. "I'll wait outside," I manage to say, hoping his decision isn't final. And so I stand there, beside him, holding onto the briefest moments we have, before pulling back to give him space.
